t: Light viscosity lubricating fluid with excellent penetrating properties, contains rust and corrosion inhibitors. Drives out moisture and is safe for use on electrical components, ideal for use in applications where water, condensation or steam create a hazard. Can be used to displace moisture in ignitions, starters, alternators, electric motors and switch gears on vehicles such as cars, buses, trucks and motorcycles. Suitable for use on high and low tension cables and wiring.
b: Safe For Use on Electrical Components
